records.claim: Optical access to the PPMS sample chamber is a purchasable option (Optical Multi-Function Probe, PPMS part P725A/B) with an axial free-beam optical port window; the base configurations (no measurement options) do not include it (the base sample chamber is closed by a KF blank flange, Hardware Manual 1070-150 sec. 2.4). OMFP temperature range is 5-350 K on DynaCool/PPMS.
records.value_as_printed: affording the user optical access to experiments

records.quote: Optical Multi-Function Probe (OMFP) DynaCool (D725A/B) / PPMS (P725A/B) / VersaLab (V725A/B) The Optical Multi-Function Probe (OMFP) offers unprecedented versatility in affording the user optical access to experiments within the variable temperature and magnetic field environment of the PPMS® family of instruments.

records.claim: The standard classic PPMS sample chamber is purged with clean gas (dewar helium boil-off by default; an alternate clean gas can be connected to the Sample Vent-Up port) through the built-in vent and flush valves (Purge/Seal operation).
records.value_as_printed: A purging procedure vents the sample chamber with clean gas
records.document_title: Physical Property Measurement System Hardware Manual, 1070-150, Rev. B5 (February 2008)
records.location: Chapter 3, Section 3.4 'Atmospheric Control', page 3-7 (see also Appendix A.3.18 'Sample Vent-Up Port', page A-7)
records.quote: The vent valve allows helium gas into the sample chamber during venting and purging procedures. A purging procedure vents the sample chamber with clean gas and pumps it out through the flush valve, and then repeats the same process two more times.

records.claim: The manual's sample-size limit for the base PPMS is set by the 2.3 cm diameter sample puck; maximum sample height 5.0 cm.

records.claim: The hardware manual defines the PPMS as an automated workstation for magnetic, electro-transport and thermo-electric measurements, and the brochure's complete options list (electrical transport, magnetometry, thermal, sub-kelvin, MFPs, FMR, optics) contains no sectioning hardware. It has no microtome, so it has no section-thickness setting.
records.document_title: Physical Property Measurement System Hardware Manual, 1070-150, Rev. B5 (February 2008)
records.location: Chapter 1, Section 1.2 'Overview of the PPMS', page 1-1 (options list: 1070-002 Rev. C1, 'Available Measurement Options')
records.quote: The Physical Property Measurement System (PPMS) provides a flexible, automated workstation that can perform a variety of experiments requiring precise thermal control. You can use the PPMS to execute magnetic, electro-transport, or thermo-electric measurements

records.claim: The PPMS is a measurement workstation (magnetic, electro-transport, thermo-electric), not a sectioning cryostat, and its complete options list has no microtome. It has no specimen/object head, so no specimen-head temperature range exists; the sample sits on a puck in the 1.9-400 K sample chamber.
